#: Strings of MO2 ApI Bridge, section "errors". Keys are short Latin labels and never change - translate the right-hand sides only. Placeholders like %(mod)s are filled in by the plugin: keep them spelled exactly, or the line is shown raw. A key starting with # is a note for translators and is ignored. To add a language, copy the folder next to this one and translate the files inside; the plugin reads whatever folders it finds, and a section may be added as a new file without touching the others.
err.badFlag: %(key)s: expected true or false, not %(value)r - a switch is no place to guess
err.badMode: mode: merge (overlay) or replace (wipe first), not %(mode)s
err.badName: the mod name must be a plain folder name, with no path separators and no colon: %(name)s
err.createFailed: createMod returned nothing - the name is taken or was refused
err.mainThread: MO2's main thread did not answer within %(sec).0f s
err.modExists: mod "%(mod)s" already exists. Nothing is written over it silently: pass mode - merge to overlay the selection, or replace to send the previous contents to the Recycle Bin first
err.needBinary: binary is required - a name REGISTERED in MO2, not a path
err.needButton: button caption required - refusing to click blindly
err.needModOrAll: mod (one or more) or all=1 is required
err.noButton: button "%(button)s" not found in this window
err.orderIncomplete: the list is incomplete or contains unknown plugins - not applied: %(missing)d missing, %(extra)d unknown
err.recycle: could not send to the Recycle Bin: %(path)s; entries already sent before this one: %(done)d
err.windowsOnly: window automation is available on Windows only
